description: Make installed app management match the backend capabilities Homebase already has: clear Open, Details, Backup, Restore, and failed-job rerun paths without forcing the operator to remember hidden routes or curl endpoints.

timing.gatingCondition: Can proceed immediately. Backend backup/restore execution and bootstrap rerun endpoints already exist; scope is mostly UI and small API quality improvements.

principles: Installed app cards should summarize and route, not become a crowded operator console
App Detail is the canonical operations center
Backup and restore must be discoverable before founder trust is possible
Failed operations should show recovery actions where the operator naturally looks
Dry-run stays the safe default, with real execution guarded by EXECUTE

techStack.runtime: Homebase static pages over raw http.createServer
techStack.storage: Existing SQLite installations, jobs, and backup_records tables
techStack.testing: node --test, UI source assertions, API tests, manual browser verification on VM

userStories.title: Installed app cards expose the complete operations path
acceptanceCriteria: Installed app cards include explicit Open and Details actions
Backup action on installed cards is no longer labeled as dry-run-only; it exposes a guarded dry-run/real choice or routes to the detail backup section
Restore action is discoverable from installed cards and routes to the app detail restore section with backup selection
Cards continue to avoid clutter on desktop and mobile
userStories.testStrategy: UI source assertions plus manual browser check on /apps with two installed apps

userStories.title: App detail becomes the canonical operations center
acceptanceCriteria: App detail top section clearly presents Open, Backup, Restore, and Deploy/Reinstall
Backup and Restore sections have stable anchors (#backup, #restore) for navigation from app cards
Submitting backup/restore shows a job link immediately
Backup history refreshes or clearly instructs refresh after a completed backup job
userStories.testStrategy: UI source assertions, endpoint dry-run job tests, manual browser flow for backup/restore dry-run and real backup

userStories.title: Backup history and first-backup prompts are visible where decisions happen
acceptanceCriteria: Installed app cards show latest backup state: never, last successful timestamp, or last failed/unknown
Newly installed apps show a first-backup prompt
App detail backup history uses SQLite records first and disk discovery fallback remains available
Dashboard can surface at least one backup summary or warning without requiring raw logs
userStories.testStrategy: SQLite backup record tests plus manual VM browser verification after taking a real backup

userStories.title: Failed jobs can be rerun from the UI
acceptanceCriteria: Failed bootstrap jobs expose rerun controls on dashboard and job detail
Failed install/backup/restore jobs expose a context-aware rerun path or an explicit reason rerun is unavailable
Rerun creates a new job and links/navigates to the new job detail
Real reruns remain guarded by EXECUTE
userStories.testStrategy: UI source assertions plus manual rerun from failed-job fixture/VM failure

userStories.title: Backup destination risk is visible before launch
acceptanceCriteria: App cards or backup sections identify whether backups are local-only
Local-only backups show a warning that they do not protect against VM/disk loss
Feature-5 is linked as the off-host destination follow-up when no off-host target is configured
The warning is visible before a founder could mistake local backup for disaster recovery
userStories.testStrategy: UI source assertions and manual browser verification on a VM with default local backup path

medium: Putting too many actions on cards can re-create the old operator-console feel
Real backup action from a summary card could be too easy to trigger without a clear confirmation pattern
low: Most backend operations already exist and are guarded
This feature is reversible UI work with focused tests

preFlightChecklist: Choose card action pattern: inline Backup panel vs route to #backup
Choose Restore card behavior: route to #restore unless a single backup can be safely preselected
Confirm latest-backup data source and whether /api/state should include backup summary or /apps should fetch per-app backups
Confirm failed-job rerun scope beyond bootstrap for first pass
Confirm mobile layout for action buttons
